name: p2c-2d-b
comment: Edge change #248's condition 2d, shape B (Fable 5.1, 2026-11-05, section 8.1): a shared 1 GiB cell at its documented capacity, 8 projects x 8,192 streams = 65,536, each touching at 75/s (150 of its 176 req/s), 6 passes. A project's creates are refused past about 16 a second (measured), so setup is paced at 13.3 a second one at a time and ends by about 655 s; the touches start at 680 s, and hold 48 in flight below the project's ceiling of 64. Both phases abort the run at the first refusal.
